root_cause.text: In af_alg_pull_tsgl, the page reassignment logic did not check that the current scatterlist entry has non-zero length (plen) before reassigning its page to the destination scatterlist, causing an extra page reassignment that can overflow the destination scatterlist.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (dst)` to `if (dst && plen)`, ensuring reassignment only occurs when there is actual data (plen > 0). The CVE description confirms that "it may try to reassign one more page than necessary" due to the missing check.
